concept_writes.content:
# arnoldi_step

One step of Arnoldi orthogonalization: extend a Krylov basis V by orthogonalizing A·V[j] against V[0..j], producing v_{j+1} and a new column of the Hessenberg matrix H.

## Signature

```
arnoldi_step :: KrylovOp -> Basis -> (Basis, HessenbergColumn)
```

## Dependencies

- `matvec` (the A·v step)
- `dot` (per-vector inner product)
- `axpy` (subtraction of projections)
- `norml2` (normalization)
